speaker: Patient
text: The pain is right in the center of my chest, feeling like a heavy weight squeezing it. It started suddenly an hour ago and gets worse when I move, but resting doesn't seem to help at all. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Myocardial Infarction (STEMI). Given the classic presentation of central crushing chest pain radiating to the left arm, accompanied by shortness of breath and nausea, immediate emergency medical services activation is required for reperfusion therapy despite the inability to order laboratory panels today.
